video_caption: Here is a description of the video segment. The segment features a man holding a little boy on the balcony of a cruise ship, with the blue ocean in the background. The man is wearing a dark-colored shirt with a printed design and a goatee. He speaks to the camera and smiles, at times, while holding the little boy. The boy is wearing a black buttoned shirt with pants and suspenders. He has curly black hair. He looks slightly disinterested at first, but smiles later. The scene then shifts to a view of the ocean from the ship, followed by an eye-level shot of the same man on the cruise balcony, where he indicates an object in the distance in the ocean. At the end of the segment, the scene shifts to inside the cruise. A man and a woman are seen walking with two children as the man records. The man is wearing the same dark shirt with printed design, but now has a black tie. The girl, wearing a dark sleeveless dress, is smiling and excited. The boy from the beginning of the video is in his father's arms, pointing to something while smiling.

In the video segment, a man with a mustache and short blonde hair, wearing a black shirt with small white stars and a tie, is holding a toddler in his arms. The toddler is dressed in a black button-down shirt and light-colored overalls. Next to them is a young girl in a black tank top with curly brown hair. All three are smiling and looking at the camera. The toddler is pointing his finger up. The man is filming with the camera, and he smiles. There is a transition to show the elevators, lit with green lights, and a sign next to the elevators that reads "7". The man walks to the elevators holding the toddler. The environment appears to be inside a cruise ship or hotel, with light-colored walls and geometric-patterned carpets. The green light indicates the direction the elevators are traveling.

On the bed next to the towels, there are printed papers titled "CRUISE COMPASS" and "YOUR TICKETS TO ADVENTURE" visible. A younger boy, dressed in a dark jacket and gray pants, walks toward a set of double doors, presumably leading to a balcony. On a table near him, there are various items, including toiletries and other personal belongings.
